description: Findings of a completed analysis: one entry per deterministic check (security headers, SEO, accessibility, performance, HTTP) and per WordPress core or plugin verification. Each finding has a stable id that means the same check in every analysis. The list is empty while the analysis is still running or when it failed; status tells which. Labels and details are in Italian.

id.description: Stable check identifier, e.g. security.content-security-policy or wordpress.plugin.contact-form-7.

status.description: ok: passed; warn: worth fixing; error: a problem.

references.description: CVE or advisory identifiers, for WordPress findings.
